svg.title: UX-10 narrow window
svg.desc: Narrow 926 by 560 window: current layout, proposed log bar, log drawer and analysis rail. Measured board sizes and restore paths for the logs.

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: UX-10 supporting figure C · Narrow window, space for the board, restoring the logs

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Window 926×560 is the narrowest the app allowed in this review (a smaller request was clamped to this width). Wireframes are to scale at 62 percent.

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Main menu button (three bars) → View → 'Move/Engine Log

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Panel'. That is 3 clicks. The row has no shortcut shown and it

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: is not in the Ctrl+K command palette (checked in the source:

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: only Search Overlay and Search Winrate Tags are). One checkbox

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: governs both logs. Nothing on screen shows that a panel is

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: hidden, and the state resets at restart.

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Proposed paths

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: • Logs: click 'Move Log' or 'Engine Log' on the always-visible bar. 1 click and

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: the drawer opens on that tab. Click the bar's chevron to fold it again.

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: • View menu: split into 'Analysis Panel', 'Move Log' and 'Engine Log' entries

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: with the same check marks. Add the same three to the Ctrl+K palette.

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: • Logs with the Analysis panel hidden: the 32 px bar then spans the full window

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: width at the bottom, so the same one click opens the drawer there.

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: • Analysis: when hidden, a 28 px rail with the label 'Analysis' stays at the

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: window edge. Click to restore.

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: • Auto-fold: below about 1000 px wide or 700 px high, start with the log bar

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: folded. A manual choice wins and is kept for the session.

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: • First-run hint: the bar's chevron is the only discoverability cue needed, so

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: no tooltip dialog or placeholder text is added (UI-08).
